messages:
maria (partnerships): Quick heads-up — QuantumBridge EAP kickoff. NDA is signed (suzanne confirmed). We need a short, runnable benchmark plan + lab access windows. Proposed timeline: week of Apr 25 => initial perf sweep; week of May 2 => deep runs and regression checks. Can eng-ml own the harness and runbook? Link: https://redwood.internal/partners/quantumbridge-eap :rocket:

jason (eng-ml): I can own the harness and CI. Need to know model variant and token lengths. Also: will partner provide hardware or do we bring reserved infra?

kevin (hw-eng): Partner said they can ship 2x QB-1 boards for remote rack access, but recommends using our Dedicated pool for comparison (we should reserve 4x A100 for baseline runs). VPN cert required for their remote console. Lab windows look like mornings PT Mon/Tue next two weeks.

suzanne (legal): NDA filed and countersigned, but clause 5b forbids sharing microcode. We need a short telemetry addendum permitting anonymized perf metrics upload to our console. I'll draft and ping them. @maria please avoid sending raw trace files until we have that signed.

devops-bot: deploy queued by @jason -> bench-run-quantumbridge; job id 0x7f9a queued at 2109876600. Monitor: /gpbench/logs/quantumbridge.

jason (eng-ml): baseline command I'll run locally (example):
```
./run_bench --model redwood-open-7b --seq 2048 --batch 8 --hw quantumbridge --out ./results/qb-baseline.json
```
I'll push harness to repos/gpbench/quantumbridge and open PR. Need SSH key from partner and a short seed prompt set.

maria (partnerships): Action items recap: 1) Jason: harness + runbook by Fri; 2) Kevin: VPN cert request + confirm lab slots; 3) Suzanne: telemetry addendum draft; 4) Maria: share timeline with partner & start PR/co-marketing doc. Tagging @leo for announcement planning later :eyes: :thumbsup:

leo (bizdev): Noted. We'll hold on any press until perf sweep looks stable. Also need to discuss a co-marketing budget and logo guidelines. I'll add a small checklist to the partner folder.

kevin (hw-eng): Thermal/telemetry note — request sampling interval of 1s on sensors, collect /sys/devices/thermal/* and nvml telemetry. I'll add a collector script to the runbook: `scripts/collect_telemetry.sh` (will include timestamps).

jason (eng-ml): Good — I'll wire those logs into our console ingestion. Dashboard will show latency p50/p95, throughput, power, and temperature. Sharing dashboard link in PR.

maria (partnerships): Calendar: scheduling a 30m sync Weds 10am PT. Invite sent. Please accept.

partner-bot (quantumbridge): Thanks Redwood team — access request received. We can provide remote attestation and hardware trace logs. POC: anita@quantumbridge.com. We agree to sign telemetry addendum once legal sends draft. Looking forward to the runs.

suzanne (legal): Draft sent to partner legal — please don't upload identifiable traces until they countersign.

jason (eng-ml): One more technical ask: confirm firmware version on QB-1 (need v1.4.2+ for perf counters). Partner, can you confirm?

partner-bot (quantumbridge): Confirmed — QB-1 firmware v1.4.3 on units allocated. We'll also provide full attestation report when VPN is live.

maria (partnerships): Great. I'll follow up after sync with a condensed action tracker. Thanks team :raised_hands:
